mem.10:
27 March 2023: Audrey and Andrew caught up. Andrew had started a Financial Analyst job the previous week. Audrey had three dogs—Pepper, Precious and Panda—and shared a photo of two wearing new collars; she’d had them for three years, adored them, and took them to parks and trails. Andrew had no dog of his own, loved animals and was fascinated by eagles. He shared a photo of two birds silhouetted against the sun, seen while hiking. He recommended Fox Hollow for a weekend hike; Audrey said she’d try it.

2 April 2023: Audrey said her household had adopted Pixie, a small white puppy, and shared a photo. She hadn’t tried Fox Hollow because Pixie kept her busy. Pixie took days to adjust to the other dogs; Pepper had also needed time and was now often with Pixie. Audrey shared photos of dogs playing and by a fence. Andrew was considering adopting but struggled to find dog-friendly city housing; Audrey suggested pet filters on housing sites. They discussed dogs as cuddle companions. Andrew shared a photo of his family’s dog on a couch; Audrey shared a dog with a pillow. Andrew missed hiking with his family dog, saying hikes build bonds and memories; he shared photos of a man walking a dog on a trail and sitting with one on a rock. Audrey said hiking with her dogs sounded appealing. Andrew hoped to find a dog-friendly home and promised updates.

16 April 2023: Andrew had tried a city café with his girlfriend the prior weekend. He missed nature and hiking; nature made him feel connected, at home in his soul, and helped him reset. He shared a photo of pastries and coffee. Audrey said nature and dog walks grounded and recharged her; caring for her pets fulfilled her and they meant the world to her. She suggested a pastry party and shared blueberry muffins; Andrew agreed. Audrey said her dogs would come and shared them running. She has tattoos of her dogs on her arm; she shared an image of a woman with a dog-and-sunflowers tattoo, saying it represented love of her pups and nature and kept their faces with her. Also shared a woman walking dogs in woods.

3 May 2023: Audrey had hiked the previous week and saw a hummingbird; shared a photo of it on a branch with wings spread. Andrew found nearby open space and tried to escape the city weekly. He shared lake and mountain sunset photos; nature was therapeutic, peaceful and invigorating, and he liked capturing calming moments. Audrey shared her dogs in a field and playing with other dogs; they loved hikes, new scents and nature. She cared about dog safety (shared a dog wearing shoes and leash). Walks included fetch (ball/frisbee) and dog-park playdates where she chatted with owners. Dogs had lots of energy and loved toys, hats and treats; she shared photos of a dog catching a frisbee and one in a party hat. She recommended a nearby dog park with trees and benches; Andrew said he’d check it out.

6 May 2023: Andrew was searching for a dog through websites, shelters and friends; it was fun but frustrating. He shared a dog peering through a cage. Audrey asked what might help and shared two dogs running in a field, one with a ball. Andrew advised considering space and breed exercise needs; his apartment might suit a small dog, while active people might want one that likes running and play. Pet-friendly housing was hard to find; he was contacting landlords and seeking neighborhoods near parks or woods. Audrey had a nearby park, great for walking her pup. On 5 May she and her dogs road-tripped to a beautiful national park, sharing three dogs running through grass. She takes them on road trips every couple of months to explore and stay active. Andrew added a road trip with a furry companion to his bucket list. Audrey wished him luck and asked for a future-dog photo; Andrew promised updates and went to another shelter.

11 May 2023: Andrew had hiked with friends and girlfriend the previous weekend; shared a dirt path to a grassy hill. Audrey said she was caring for four dogs and had enrolled in a positive-reinforcement training workshop for the following month. The flyer was at her local pet store; a volunteer let her meet their friendly, playful dog. She thought her quick-learning dogs would respond well to rewards and promised news/tips. She believed pets should be taught with positive reinforcement, not punishment; hurting her dogs pained her. Andrew agreed and would look into classes.

2 June 2023: Audrey took her pups to the park on 1 June; they ran and played off leash, bringing joy and peace. Andrew shared a sunset mountain photo with a grazing horse. Audrey said she’d taken her dogs to a national park the previous week, reached a beautiful peak at sunset, and described scenery, breeze, birdsong and dogs running as “a slice of paradise.” She shared two horses in a field by a fence. Nature cheered her and made her grateful. Andrew was still seeking a dog but had not found pet-friendly housing; discouraged but determined. Audrey offered to search if he emailed criteria.

13 June 2023: Andrew and friends took a rock-climbing class the previous Sunday. He reached the top; it was challenging but satisfying, with friends’ support. Shared the view from the top and a man climbing. He was hooked and hoped for weekly outdoor activities, including kayaking and maybe bungee jumping; nature pushed him out of his comfort zone. Audrey invited him to walk with her dogs on a small, tree-lined park trail; he accepted, eager to meet them. She shared dogs playing with balls/frisbees. Walks usually lasted about an hour, varied by day, and let dogs explore at their pace. Walks are their favorite part of the day; their faces brighten when she gets ready to take them out. Outdoors with them is her happy place. Both said nature refreshed them, gave perspective, and made them feel alive and centered.

26 June 2023: Audrey had moved to a new place with a bigger backyard for the dogs; they loved running and sniffing new smells. She set up agility equipment and toys. Andrew shared a nearby doggy daycare’s indoor play area; Audrey planned to check it out. He offered help finding dog-friendly places. Both said pets are family and bring joy; Audrey disliked people hating or hurting pets. Andrew shared a neighborhood park flower bed. He’d hiked with friends the previous Friday and enjoyed birdsong, tree scents and being outdoors. Audrey shared feet resting on a rock above a lake and recalled a peaceful mountain-lake hike with friends several years earlier. They agreed to appreciate life’s small things.

3 July 2023: Audrey said her dog-training course was challenging but rewarding; the dogs were already doing better. Andrew still couldn’t find dog-friendly rentals and asked about new trails; Audrey had little time for trails due to training. Andrew said he was limited to urban adventures for now. Audrey shared two dogs running with a ball. The dogs are all mutts: two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes; all four are three years old and a great pack. They love running and fetch. Audrey shared dogs curled in a bed and on a couch under a blanket; she said they were her universe. They’d had a fun, slightly chaotic doggy playdate the prior Friday.

Andrew had recently taken up cooking because he couldn’t hike; it helped him de-stress and be creative, though he was a rookie. Audrey loves cooking, experimenting with recipes, and finds it calming and therapeutic. Her favorite recipe is family chicken pot pie, associated with her grandma’s kitchen and conversations at the table; she offered to send Andrew the recipe and shared pie photos. She likes music and a glass of wine while cooking. Garlic is her go-to ingredient. She offered her roasted-chicken recipe, based on Mediterranean flavors: chicken, garlic, lemon and herbs; it’s an easy, healthy comfort meal. Andrew appreciated the ideas and promised to report how the recipes turned out.
mem.19:
Andrew and Audrey have been catching up since March 2023. Andrew works as a Financial Analyst and lives in the city; he has struggled to find pet-friendly housing. He checked rental sites, shelters and friends while looking to adopt, feeling discouraged at times but determined. On 6 May he said apartment living made a smaller dog seem best; he advised considering space and breed exercise needs. On 11 July he got Toby, a smart, loyal German Shepherd puppy. Andrew and his girlfriend later volunteered at a shelter (27 July); he said volunteering was his way of giving back and improving animals’ lives. He enjoys hiking, usually trying to get out of the city at least weekly, and nature helps him reset. He also tried rock climbing, fishing and cooking. Work stress sometimes limited outdoor time; daily resets included morning coffee and a lunchtime walk.

Audrey has four three-year-old mutts: Pepper, Precious, Panda and Pixie—two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes. Her household adopted small white puppy Pixie on 2 Apr 2023; Pepper helped her settle in. Audrey loves her dogs, calling them her universe/everything. They enjoy walks (their favorite part of the day; their faces brighten when she gets ready), fetch with a ball or frisbee, hikes, new scents, and exploring nature. Their wagging tails show how much they enjoy hikes. Audrey walks them multiple times daily, uses leashes/shoes for safety, and arranges park playdates with other dogs and owners. She recommends the nearby dog park. She took a positive-reinforcement training course, later started agility classes twice weekly, and groomed her dogs after a course. She teaches obedience and tricks (sit, stay, shake, roll over); training advice: patience, love, regular practice, praise, gentle grooming. She says a puppy needs time, attention, walks and energy—especially an active German Shepherd like Toby. The dogs tolerate party hats for fun and treats.

Audrey moved to a house with a bigger backyard, toys and agility equipment (26 Jun). A vet trip with all four was chaotic, so she planned to take them one at a time. Favorite dog spots: Pepper on couch, Pixie in her bed, Precious in her chair, Panda on his rug. She has dog tattoos: an arm tattoo of a dog and sunflowers, representing dogs and nature (before 16 Apr); on 16 Aug she got another arm tattoo depicting all four so they’d be with her wherever she went. Four was enough because she wanted to give each attention. Audrey’s childhood dog Max was a close companion; she and Max took long neighborhood walks, explored paths, and she shared worries and hopes with him. Those walks are favorite memories.

Audrey enjoys nature, trails and national-park trips every few months; nature and dog walks ground her. She once described a sunset-peak hike as “a slice of paradise.” She invited Andrew to walk with her dogs (June); they walked about an hour. They planned an August hike with Toby once he was old enough, checking trail safety. Audrey shared many dog, hiking and nature photos. Andrew shared hikes, sunsets, lake/mountain views and nature photos; he found nature therapeutic. He hiked with friends on 23 Jun and took photos, and hiked over the 2–3 Sep weekend to escape the city, seeing a beautiful sunset; his photo showed a person on a mountain overlooking the city. He also shared a dirt path leading to a grassy hill. Audrey suggested Fox Hollow for a hike (27 Mar); Andrew missed exploring trails with his family dog and said hiking with a dog builds bonds and memories. Audrey road-tripped with the dogs to a national park (5 May). Andrew and girlfriend camped in August; Toby was too young to hike as of 6 Sep.

Other details: Audrey loves cooking; family chicken pot pie recalls her grandmother’s kitchen. She offered Andrew the recipe and Mediterranean roasted chicken with garlic, lemon and herbs; she likes music and wine while cooking and uses lots of garlic. Andrew and girlfriend found a café with tempting pastries, having croissants, muffins and tarts (date unspecified); Audrey shared blueberry muffins for a pastry party. Audrey keeps a small garden with flowers and a veggie patch; in September she described Peruvian lilies as easy to grow with sun and water. Andrew shared balcony flowers.

24 Sep 2023: Audrey said a dog (identified as Precious by Andrew) pulled so hard at the park the prior Friday that the leash broke. Audrey chased and caught her safely, then petted and hugged her, spoke calmly and walked her slowly to settle her. She shared a red retractable leash photo. Andrew asked how to build trust with Toby; Audrey advised patience, regular training, time, love and praise. Her dogs practice obedience and tricks and go on walks multiple times daily. Audrey said they are all mutts and bring her joy; Andrew shared a frisbee-playing dog photo and balcony flowers. Audrey said gardening relaxes her; she has a vegetable patch and Peruvian lilies. Her dogs enjoy running and exploring the garden; they mostly play with one another. They mean everything to her.

Other dates: 16 Apr Andrew missed nature while living in the city; Audrey said dog walks ground her. 3 May Audrey saw a hummingbird hiking. 6 Sep Audrey encouraged self-care; she tries one small self-care activity daily. Andrew had recently hiked to a sunset viewpoint. Audrey checked on his housing search; he still hadn’t found a pet-friendly place. On 27 Jul Andrew, girlfriend and Toby volunteered at a shelter.
mem.28:
Andrew and Audrey have been catching up since March 2023.

**Andrew:** City-dwelling financial analyst with a girlfriend. Loves animals, hiking, ecology, birdwatching, greenery, mountains and fresh air; nature helps him escape work/city stress. Enjoys weekly hikes, morning coffee, lunchtime walks; eagles awe him. Has tried rock climbing and fishing; cooking relaxes him. He and his girlfriend enjoy city eateries, visited a farm for vegetables 16 Aug 2023, went wine tasting the weekend before 24 Oct, and found a café with irresistible pastries (croissants, muffins, tarts); Andrew shared a photo of pastries and coffee. On 18 Aug he took a work break to visit a new café.

**Andrew’s dogs:** Toby, adopted 11 Jul 2023 after a difficult search, is active, smart, loyal, likes sweaters, and once chased a squirrel around a tree. Andrew and girlfriend volunteered with Toby at a shelter 27 Jul. Toby was too young to hike as of 6 Sep. Andrew has long wanted to learn dog grooming but lacked time. Buddy, a shelter pup, was adopted by 19 Oct; he likes walks, exploring and new trails. Toby needed time to adjust; Andrew hoped they’d become buddies and planned hikes with them. On 22 Nov Andrew said he had adopted Scout “the other day,” making three dogs: Toby, Buddy and Scout. He and girlfriend bought Scout a bed, toys and puppy pads, planned gradual introductions, and a leashed first outing to a nearby small park. Scout’s name was chosen for his adventurous spirit. Andrew enjoys walks with Buddy. Nearby daycare has a large indoor play area. Andrew considered a third dog 4 Nov, unsure he could manage it, then agreed to focus on Toby and Buddy; by 22 Nov he had adopted Scout.

**Andrew’s nature/photos/plans:** Hiked with friends and girlfriend 6–7 May, friends 23 Jun; camped with girlfriend in August. Shared sunset-hike photos 2–3 Sep (person overlooking city from mountain; dirt path to grassy hill). Other shared photos: mountain sunset with church, ocean sunset, beach walker with surfboard, remote dirt road with cow and red truck. Fox Hollow is a weekend trail with great views. On 4 Oct missed nature, planned houseplants; has balcony flowers. Visits parks/hikes when possible. Planned November beach trip with girlfriend and Toby (1 Oct). On 4 Nov he and girlfriend biked to a park outside town; photo showed two people biking on paved path. Planned picnic date with girlfriend Sunday 29 Oct.

**Audrey and dogs:** Four dogs—Pepper, Precious, Panda and Pixie—described as about 3 years old. Pixie, small white puppy, adopted 2 Apr; took days to adjust, then played with the others. Pepper initially needed time but became Pixie’s constant companion. Breed accounts conflict: earlier Pepper and Precious were Jack Russell mixes, Panda and Pixie Chihuahua mixes; 28 Oct Audrey said all mutts, Pepper/Panda Lab mixes and Precious/Pixie Chihuahua mixes. Dogs are her family/universe and give her joy, love, companionship and meaning. Oldest relaxed/wise, second playful, third naughty but cuddly, youngest lively/adventurous. Might want more dogs someday, but four keep her busy and let her give each attention. On 11 May she said much of her free time goes to their care and happiness.

Dogs enjoy daily walks, parks/trails, fetch/frisbee, sniffing, running and meeting dogs. Audrey walks them several times daily, uses leashes/shoes for safety, arranges playdates and recommends dog parks for mingling. Dogs dislike snow, prefer sunny grass. Favorite spots: Pepper couch, Pixie bed, Precious chair, Panda rug. Audrey takes them on road trips about every couple of months. Moved to a bigger house with backyard 26 Jun and was unpacking; yard has toys/agility equipment. Doggy playdate 30 Jun was crazy but fun. Vet visit with all four was chaotic; planned separate visits. Completed positive-reinforcement training; began agility twice weekly and groomed dogs after a course. Teaches sit/stay/shake/roll over; advises patience, praise and gentle grooming. Dogs tolerate party hats for treats. Made personalized wooden name tags/keychains 11 Jul. Precious broke her leash at park before 24 Sep; Audrey caught and comforted her safely. On 28 Oct dogs had been acting unusually; saw behaviorist the previous Wednesday. Appointment was hectic but okay; behaviorist suggested routine changes/approaches. Audrey used positive reinforcement; dogs responded, progress ongoing. Audrey joined dog-owners group by 4 Nov, meeting weekly for tips and dog play. Dogs had a fun outing the previous weekend. Indoor puzzles, training and hide-and-seek offer stimulation; Andrew planned to try them.

Audrey had childhood dog Max; favorite memory was neighborhood walks. Tattoos: dog and sunflowers by 16 Apr; four dogs by 16 Aug, flowers added 13 Oct; feels tattoos are enough unless another dog. Loves national parks as refuge; road-tripped with dogs to one 5 May, called sunset-peak hike “a slice of paradise,” saw hummingbird 3 May. A few years before 26 Jun, hiked with friends to a mountain lake; they sat talking and admiring nature, a calming memory. On 2 Jun shared favorite hiking photo of two horses in a fenced field. Finds outdoors with dogs peaceful, inspiring and her happy place; dogs and nature bring joy/peace. Walked dogs about an hour with Andrew in June; agreed to hike with him in August when weather was pleasant. Andrew shared a trail map; Audrey would check safety for off-leash running. On 2 Jun she offered to help Andrew find a suitable dog and asked him to email criteria. Had not visited discussed trail 2 Apr due to Pixie. Encouraged Andrew to do a small daily self-care activity 6 Sep. Knee injury once stopped walks; shared dogs running after she resumed 6 Oct. Accident playing with pups week before 24 Oct; arm in cast, managing care one-handed and improving. On 16 Aug enjoyed a day outside with dogs and said she’d cherish it. On 4 Oct offered Andrew plant advice.

**Shared interests:** Audrey wanted to try birdwatching; Andrew offered to go together. She’d check schedule/learn local birds; shared guidebook/binoculars. Andrew would bring binoculars/notebook; photo shared of pen/notebook/camera. Discussed ecology, conservation and nature’s interconnectedness. Audrey recycles and usually takes transit; Andrew suggested biking and offered river routes, no date set. In October discussed a dog hike for November; Audrey was excited to make memories. Audrey planned to research a beautiful place after Andrew shared the dirt-road photo. Andrew advised trust-building with Toby through patience, training, time and praise; Audrey encouraged positive reinforcement. They value their friendship and mutual support.

**Audrey’s other interests:** Loves cooking; grandmother’s chicken pot pie recalls her kitchen. Offered recipe and Mediterranean roast chicken (garlic, lemon, herbs); enjoys music/wine while cooking and lots of garlic. Gardens flowers/vegetables; Peruvian lilies are easy (sun/water), gardening relaxing. Makes jewelry from recycled bottle caps, buttons and broken jewelry; hobby became a business, some profits donated to animal shelter. Shared colorful necklace/earrings and favorite necklace photos. Baked blueberry muffins for pastry party and treats for neighbors with pup-friendly homes 13 Oct.

**22 Nov 2023:** Audrey took dogs to pet salon the previous Friday; they were excited, settled down, behaved well. Shared grooming photo (dog on table with leash), shiny coats; said she worries about new places and felt she was doing well as a dog mom. Andrew hadn’t yet groomed his dogs but planned to. Audrey advised gradual park exposure, leashing and slow introductions; shared photo of dog running with tennis ball. Andrew shared Scout photo (woman feeding dog hay in barn). Audrey’s dogs were doing well, exploring and meeting people; both agreed dogs bring joy, friendship and are family.
